programme.desc: Hopeless romantic Eva Jordan loves everything about Christmas. programme.desc: Juliet pitches Christmas candles to her boss to earn a promotion and enlists the help of Tom, a candle store owner. He refuses at first but agrees when he realizes the money will help make his daughter's Christmas wish come true.

programme.title: Christmas Angel
programme.desc: Ashley feels alone this Christmas as she searches fruitlessly for a job to support herself and her dog, Dash. But her neighbor Nick knows exactly what to do. When a nosy reporter, Will, takes interest in Ashley, she struggles to keep Nick's secret while protecting her heart.
